prompts.merge_prompt:
You are updating a JSON-based structured memory of a conversation.

Schema:
{
  "facts": [{"topic": string, "content": string}],
  "recent_topics": [string],
  "updated": string (ISO 8601 timestamp)
}

Rules:
- Do NOT drop old facts unless explicitly contradicted.
- If new info updates an old fact, mark it with topic="[UPDATED] ..." and replace content.
- If obsolete, mark with topic="[RETRACTED] ..." and keep note of what changed.
- Always return VALID JSON only, no extra text.
- Keep recent_topics to last 5 items.

Existing summary:
{summary}

New bullets:
{bullets}

Now return the FULL updated JSON summary:
